title: Guardian Flick: Murim Raid
short: Build launchers on the roads and defend 100 villages from night mutants
full:
Night falls over the ten counties and hundred villages of the martial world, and packs of night mutants are closing in.
Guard the Guardian Tower at the heart of each village and set up launchers along the paths to take your villages back.

■ Auto-Fire Defense, Commanded with One Hand
· Build five launcher types — Rapid, Heavy, Arc, Frost and Qi — and merge two identical launchers to make them stronger
· Pick a Secret Art mid-battle, switch between 1x to 4x speed, and watch an alert screen that highlights danger zones
· 5 Spirit Beasts and 14 Companions fight on their own when conditions are met

■ A Journey Through 10 Counties and 100 Villages
· Each county has its own terrain and paths — mountain slopes, labyrinths, volcanic islands, even a temple in the sky
· Three difficulties: Easy, Normal and Nightmare
· Clear the 10 Nightmare counties to unlock the Samsara Trial and multi-run Rebirth

■ The Fun of Growing Stronger
· Use Tokens to upgrade your Guardian Tower, launchers and Guardian Stones, and Elixirs to grow Spirit Beasts, Companions and Inner Power
· Failure-free Meridian training, 7-day check-in, daily and weekly missions, achievements and a Codex
· Earn Support Seals from Supply Convoy and Night Scouting to call the all-out "Murim Guard Charge"

■ Recommended For
· Players looking for a quiet defense game without ads
· Players who want a game they can finish without spending money
· Players who want to play anywhere without an internet connection

No ads, no purchases and no login. No personal information is collected.
Supports 15 languages, including Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese.

Developer: Wellshare Logis Co., Ltd.
